name: edit_batch
description: MUST USE for all file edits. PREFERRED single-file edit path. Read first, then edit. Multiple edits, atomic, dry_run previews diff. Rollback/multi-file? edit_transaction.

file.description: Path to the file to edit, relative to workspace_dir (e.g. "src/auth.py")

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

file_path.description: DEPRECATED: abs path alias, only inside workspace

verbose.description: Return original_content/final_content full text (default: false — diff only)

old_string.description: Text to search for (must uniquely match)

edits.description: Array of edits to apply. Example: [{"old_string": "foo", "new_string": "bar"}]

dry_run.description: Preview changes as unified diff, do not apply

partial.description: Apply successful edits even if some fail (returns applied/failed indices)
